name: Downrush
author: Jamie Fenton
summary: A polyphonic synth running the synth engine of the open-source Deluge community firmware 1.3.0: subtractive, FM and ring mod, sample oscillators, a 24-cable mod matrix, arpeggiator, and it loads and saves Deluge SYNTH preset files. Needs MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. Tested on a Force.
